Identical values between Zheng and Zhao (2022) and Grandchamp et al. (2023):

DeNovoGeneAnnotation:

	inputData:
		transcriptome

	inputTranscriptome:

		transContextChoice:
			intergenic
			antisense
			intronic
			overlap gene

	homologyFilter:

		seqType:
			protein sequences

		dataBase:
			custom choice
